attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Small, targeted fix that clears any pre-existing IConfigureOptions<KeyManagementOptions> registrations before adding the module-specific one, reducing risk of duplicate/conflicting key management setups, but could subtly change behavior for setups relying on multiple KeyManagementOptions configurations."}

reason: Small, targeted fix that clears any pre-existing IConfigureOptions<KeyManagementOptions> registrations before adding the module-specific one, reducing risk of duplicate/conflicting key management setups, but could subtly change behavior for setups relying on multiple KeyManagementOptions configurations.
